about: Survival and health V1a (docs/gameplay/survival_health_v1a.md): 100 HP, damage taken by players scaled after armour, natural regeneration, wounds. All numbers are game balance parameters.

rules.about: lightning (world/LightningStrikes, 1000): lethal as it is, not scaled

hunger.about: Basal hunger (docs/gameplay/world_time_b_units_v1.md 6): food points a game hour standing still, on top of the exhaustion from acting; applied as exhaustion, saturation first. 20 / 72: a full bar in three game days, as thirst.

fracture.about: Fractures and splints V1 (docs/gameplay/fracture_splint_v1_plan.md). Pairs are [not splinted, splinted]; every penalty fades out linearly from fade_from of the healing. A fall breaks a leg with chance clamp((health lost - [0]) / [1], 0, [2]), the side at random; an arm only when the player falls over (fall_over), the arm it lands on (docs/gameplay/fall_landing_v1_plan.md).

knockdown.about: Injury knockdown V1 (docs/gameplay/injury_knockdown_v1_plan.md 3): a hit from somewhere that does not kill knocks the player down with chance clamp((health lost - [0]) / [1], 0, [2]); + load above the light load, x broken_leg with a leg broken, + sprint, x sneak; the types in always knock down from always_min health lost. P9 30 -> 17 %, BR-51 62 -> always. The held item drops with drop.

collapse.about: Collapse (plan 4): a hit leaving at most 'at' health drops the player onto the front, crawling x crawl; up after min_seconds once health is back to up_at, or after max_seconds. Slow harm (ignore) does not.

vehicle.about: Vehicle impact (plan 5, vehicle/VehicleImpact): closing speed (m/s) -> health lost of 100 (passed / 5, the vanilla scale; 20 km/h 15, 50 km/h 90). From min_speed (walking pace, a truck backing up slowly) a bump; a player is thrown down as a living ragdoll from knock_speed, below it only flinches and is shoved (2026-10-22). Thrown along the hit at throw_factor x closing x mass / (mass + its mass), up at lift x closing (at most lift_max m/s); its mass = box volume x density. A player's leg breaks with chance clamp((d - [0]) / [1], 0, [2]).
